description: This is a Java unit test class for the UserRestEndpoint class, testing RESTful endpoints related to User operations in a Spring Boot context with Mockito and PowerMock frameworks.

classes.name: UserRestEndpointUTest
classes.description: Unit test class for UserRestEndpoint focusing on testing REST API methods for User operations.

methods.name: getUserWithUserIdShouldReturnTheUser
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a user by ID returns the correct UserResource with HTTP status OK.

methods.name: createUserShouldCreateUser
methods.description: Tests that creating a new user via the REST endpoint calls the UserService to create the user.

methods.name: testUpdateUser
methods.description: Tests that updating an existing user invokes the update method on UserService.

methods.name: testDeleteUser
methods.description: Tests that deleting a user by ID calls the deleteUser method on UserService.
